selection_rationale: Reference monitors common in French and international studios, broadcast and schools: Genelec (8030C from the TekPractice catalog, 8341A coaxial SAM, 1234A main, 7360A sub), Neumann (KH 120 II, KH 420 midfield, KH 750 DSP sub), French-made Focal (Shape 65, Trio6, Utopia Main 112), ADAM (A7V, S3H midfield) and Yamaha HS8. Monitor controllers span a high-end digital hub (Grace m905, in catalog), an analog controller (Drawmer MC2.1) and an entry-level controller/USB interface (Mackie Big Knob Studio). Models were chosen for distinctive wiring lessons: AES3 thru daisy-chains, S/PDIF on RCA, AES3 on BNC, separate amplifier racks on Speakon NL4/NL8, bass-management subwoofers and talkback/cue paths.

devices.technology: Active analog desktop monitor controller: 4 stereo inputs (XLR, XLR/jack combo, shared RCA / 3.5 mm aux), 3 stereo balanced speaker outputs + mono sub output on XLR with underside trims, 2 headphone amps, built-in electret talkback mic with rear talkback output, linear power supply.
devices.why_it_is_a_classic: A widely used analog monitor controller format: source select, speaker A/B/C switching with calibration trims, mono / dim / mute / phase / L-R cut and talkback. Drawmer's manual includes a step-by-step pink-noise calibration procedure, useful for teaching.
typical_uses: project and professional studio monitor switching

key_specs.inputs: I/P1 balanced Neutrik XLR; I/P2 balanced Neutrik XLR/jack combi; AUX shared stereo RCA and 3.5 mm stereo jack
key_specs.outputs: 3 stereo balanced speaker outputs + mono speaker/sub-woofer output, Neutrik 3-pin XLR, individual L/R/mono trims
key_specs.talkback: Built-in electret microphone, level control, 1/4" mono talkback output jack, auto dim -20 dB
key_specs.crosstalk: L/R @ 1 kHz >85 dB; adjacent input >95 dB

tekpractice.sim_value_reason: Pure analog monitor path with XLR, combo, RCA and 3.5 mm inputs, three speaker sets plus sub and talkback out: clear source → controller → monitors lesson.

devices.technology: Desktop monitor controller with built-in 2x2 USB audio interface (192 kHz / 24-bit): 2 Onyx mic preamps on XLR/TRS combo with phantom, 3 sources, 2 monitor pairs on 1/4" outputs, 2-track outputs, 2 headphone outputs, internal talkback mic; external universal power supply.
devices.why_it_is_a_classic: Mackie's own manual calls the Big Knob 'the world's bestselling monitor controller' (manufacturer claim). The Studio version merges monitor control and a USB interface, a common setup in home and school studios.

key_specs.mic_inputs: 2 x XLR and 1/4" TRS combo, Onyx preamps, phantom power
key_specs.line_inputs: 1 pair 1/4" source inputs (rear); 1/8" (3.5 mm) stereo input (front) which defeats the 1/4" inputs
key_specs.usb: 2x2 USB audio interface, 192 kHz / 24-bit (class compliant on Mac; ASIO driver on PC)
key_specs.outputs: 1/4" monitor outputs (balanced); 1/4" 2-track outputs switchable +4 dBu / -10 dBV; 2 headphone outputs with independent level
key_specs.functions: Mono, mute, dim (-20 dB), independent trims on sources and monitor outputs, 16-segment input metering
key_specs.frequency_response: ±0.5 dB, 20 Hz - 20 kHz (unity gain, +4 dBu input, all inputs)
key_specs.power: External universal power supply 100 VAC to 240 VAC
key_specs.dimensions: Height 3.2 in / 81 mm, width 9.9 in / 251 mm, depth 6.4 in / 163 mm
